readme: Known accessibility violations, by state of the app and kind of element, with how many (count). a11y.spec.ts fails on a kind that is not listed or that there are more of than listed, and on an entry that no longer occurs or that there are fewer of: lower or remove it. Rewrite with UPDATE_A11Y_BASELINE=1 (never on CI); see docs/testing/a11y.md. conditional (may be absent) and countVaries (the number is not compared) each carry the reason.

violations.element: <span class="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-caption font-medium" style="background-color:#DC262620;color:#DC2626">
